about.title: Who is Lucas Tavares
about.p1: I'm Necromante96Official — I build tools, sites and game experiences. My mod hit 18.5k views (457 favs, 143 ratings), I shipped official PT-BR for Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call and the Hytale PT-BR pack on CurseForge, and I'm translating Dragon Quest I & II Remake and Elementallis.
about.p2: On the web/systems side, I built FisioHub for the ESEFID/UFRGS clinic (TypeScript + Vite + 3 Chrome Extensions, offline & private) and the Finance Control PWA (offline-first, installable, build 281). Hardcore: Forbidden Legacy Patch Manager (C# .NET 9 + Avalonia, Python + pycryptodome, Godot PCK v4 + GDRE) and Nexus Translator (31 modules, Cursor SDK, Unity/IL2CPP).
about.p3: I like simple on the surface, solid engineering underneath. Premium minimal design, performance and docs that hold up.
